changes: First release, for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74: MrScruff's Main RMS, ported to elemod by Iced-Cream, with his code unchanged.
On the compressor pages, the VOL label draws inverted while the main output is louder than -18 dBFS RMS, for gain staging.
